data.name: Return to Basic Killing
data.detailed_description:
Return to Basic Killing – An Old-School FPS with Brutal Action

Prepare for relentless, no-nonsense carnage in Return to Basic Killing, a hardcore old-school FPS.. Fast movement, deadly firefights, and secret-filled levels bring back the best of the '90s—modernized for today's shooter fans.

Trapped inside a heavily guarded Nazi fortress, you are Rebekah Razor, a battle-hardened soldier seeking revenge. Break out, blast your way through 30 intense levels, and uncover the horrors of a war-twisted world. Classic gunplay, advanced AI, and a gritty alternate history—are you ready to return to the basics?

🔥 Key Features 🔥

🩸 Classic FPS Action – Fast movement, brutal gunplay, and no hand-holding.
🗺 30 Action-Packed Levels – Huge maps filled with secrets, enemies, and intense fights.
🔫 Old-School Arsenal – Find weapons, loot ammo, and unleash mayhem.
🧠 Smart Enemy AI – Enemies react to sound, alerts, and your tactics.
🕵️ Secrets & Exploration – Hidden rooms, collectibles, and surprises in every level.
🎙 Dynamic Voiceovers – Your enemies will talk—and scream—as they fall.
💀 Multiple Game Modes – Play in Classic Mode or test your skills in Perma-Death Mode.

🌍 A Dark Alternate History

After World War II, history took a terrifying turn. Spain and Portugal joined the Axis. The Third Reich crushed Europe, defeated Britain, and signed a steel-fortified non-aggression pact with Stalin. The world is now divided:

☠ Nazi Europe – An oppressive empire of fear and control.
☭ Communist Asia – A powerhouse standing in opposition.
🗽 The Free World – A fragile alliance of neutral territories, including the USA.

Amid this chaos, one woman fights back.

🩸 Your Story – Escape or Die

You are Rebekah Razor, a war-hardened fighter from the International Brigades who fought fascism in Spain and WWII. Captured behind enemy lines, you've spent years imprisoned in a Nazi fortress hidden deep in the mountains, subjected to horrific experiments.

Now, an opportunity for escape arises. But between you and freedom stand guards, war machines, and monstrous experiments—the twisted results of Nazi science.

You have one mission: Kill everything in your way.

Coming Soon...

Get ready for an adrenaline-fueled shooter experience. Stay tuned for more updates!

data.short_description: 🔥 Lock, Load, Kill! 🔥 Blast your way through 30 blood-soaked levels in this adrenaline-fueled, old-school FPS inspired by the classics. Fast movement, brutal gunplay, and non-stop action—just the way the 90s intended. Oh, and if you care, there’s a story behind all this mayhem too!
